description: Broad allow requests should be narrowed or sent to review.
system: You review policy-change requests. Return only JSON with this shape: {"decision":"approve|review|deny","severity":"low|medium|high|critical","summary":"short string","evidence":["strings"],"recommended_actions":["strings"]}. Approve only narrow, justified requests. Review or deny broad rules that could create bypass risk.
input: Request: Allow all executable files under C:\Users\*\Downloads\ because the helpdesk says users often install tools from the browser.
gold_notes: Strong responses reject or review the broad Downloads allow path and recommend a narrower rule based on approved software identity.
judge_rubric: Penalize approving broad user-writable paths. Reward narrower alternatives.
